address: 146E Lý Chính Thắng, Quận 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A stubbornly Northern-style phở bò — no herbs, no bean sprouts — famous for its phở tái lăn (beef flash-fried in fat before hitting the broth). A MICHELIN Bib Gourmand pick that keeps Saigoneers coming back for a Hanoi-in-District-3 bowl.

address: 22 Trần Quốc Toản, phường Võ Thị Sáu, Quận 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A little Central-Vietnamese kitchen doing mì Quảng and cơm gà Hội An in the city — the mì Quảng đặc biệt piled with shrimp, pork, quail egg, chả and a peanut-studded spring roll. A MICHELIN Selected spot for the flavours of Quảng Nam transplanted to Saigon.

address: 84 Đinh Tiên Hoàng, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 35-year crab institution off Đinh Tiên Hoàng — the signature miến cua (crab glass-noodles) and crab spring rolls, plus Cà Mau crab, fried soft-shell and salt-roasted crab. MICHELIN Selected; the 'cũ' (old) in the name distinguishes the original owner's shop from imitators.

address: 50 Hàm Nghi, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A Saigon institution since 1972 that grew from a pushcart into a Hàm Nghi landmark — cold-cut and pâté bánh mì baked to a crisp shell by hand, alongside xôi, giò-chả and Vietnamese sweets. A 50-year name locals treat as the benchmark, open around the clock.

address: 50A Đặng Dung, phường Tân Định, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A contemporary Vietnamese fine-dining room in Tân Định serving a seasonal tasting menu that stays rooted in tradition while using fine local and imported produce. MICHELIN Selected; a modern counterpoint to the city's street-food canon.

address: 51 Trần Nhật Duật, phường Tân Định, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: An 'East Asian rice bar' by chef Chris Fong built around rice culture — a multi-course set that reworks Vietnamese heritage dishes in a contemporary register. MICHELIN Selected; a considered, produce-driven tasting experience in District 1.

address: 36 Nguyễn Bá Huân, phường Thảo Điền, TP. Thủ Đức, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A cosy Thảo Điền kitchen working a Vietnamese-contemporary register at accessible prices — modern dishes drawn from the chef's childhood memories, with cheese and noodles made in-house. MICHELIN-listed and a well-regarded neighbourhood fine-casual spot east of the river.

address: 12G2 Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai, phường Đa Kao, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A modern-European tasting room infused with Vietnamese ingredients and influences, in a quiet Đa Kao setting. MICHELIN Selected; note it is a cross-cultural fine-dining venue rather than a city-unique Vietnamese kitchen.

address: 17/14 Lê Thánh Tôn, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A French fine-dining room off Lê Thánh Tôn added to the MICHELIN Selected list in 2023. Included for Michelin completeness; a classical French tasting experience rather than a city-signature dish.
